notes: Corrected: ba-nephesh is divided as by reason of (the preposition, headed on reason) + the (the assimilated article) + life (the noun). The accepted alignment folded the article into the compound preposition's fused unit and then treated the ASV's the as supplied on the noun, which contradicts rule 12 and rule 30's own limit, since the written the before life is English spent on that one morpheme.

Both copular pronouns take the ASV's is, on the principle that a present morpheme takes its English before a supplied reading does; the competing reading puts the first is on the prepositional predicate under rule 49.
The cleft that of it is the blood that maketh atonement is added under rule 55, since the antecedent is written and no relative morpheme stands in the clause.
